Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4p6io9$d...@vixen.cso.uiuc.edu>,

Mikel L. Matthews Jr. <gh...@prairienet.org> wrote:
>Friends,
>In combat, If I manuever out to
>long range and use a thrown Gate,
>then Blur, are my 1 (or 2) additional
>strikes also thrown gates or do I need
>something else that's ranged?

You need something else. A strike card can only be used for one
strike (weapons excepted, of course).
